-- Mod/src/com/x/BMgr.java --
package com.x;
public class BMgr {
  void addMapping(BComponent point, BImportMap m) {
    BOrd ord = point.getSlotPathOrd();
    if (ord == null || ord.isNull()) return;
    m.setTargetOrd(ord);
  }
}
-- Mod/src/com/x/BTern.java --
package com.x;
public class BTern {
  void a(BComponent p, BImportMap m) {
    BOrd o = p.getSlotPathOrd();
    m.setTargetOrd(o == null ? BOrd.NULL : o);
  }
}
